revision: K1.2 vented stop and retainer development

stop.note: Nominal bonded height is 0.1262 mm. Measure the actual laminated height; adhesive compression and film tolerance are not a force rating.

plate.material: Annealed 304 stainless, 0.30 mm, formed with the matching tool
plate.note: The original leading nail outline is retained over its first 1 mm; other edges reserve room for the silicone retainer.

cover.foot_bond_material: Smooth-On Sil-Poxy; qualify the actual silicone-to-polyimide joint on coupons
cover.stiffness_scope: Illustrative retainer-bypass sensitivity only. No cured-skirt stiffness has been measured.

plate_ground_bonds.wire: Fine stranded insulated wire; two independent plate bonds and a slack loop
plate_ground_bonds.note: Bond after the silicone cover cures. The two connections must pass through the metal plate; one goes to ground drive and one to the ADC return monitor.
